summary: The bill directs the Interior Secretary to create a temporary beautification program coordinating federal and local efforts to clean and restore DC public spaces and monuments, while also establishing a presidentially chaired interagency commission to recommend policies strengthening immigration enforcement, crime reduction, police staffing, concealed-carry processing, pretrial detention, and federal-local law enforcement presence in the District.

scores.thoughts: The bill directs the Department of the Interior to establish a program to coordinate and maintain the cleanliness of commonly visited areas in DC, including parks, and restore damaged federal public monuments. This involves environmental maintenance and protection of public spaces, albeit on a local scale.
